title: Shawnee Mission Park Marina
specs: Boats can be reserved online up to 7 days prior
Must be 12 years or older to rent a boat
Must be 12 years or older to occupy a boat without guardian
Children under 12 must be accompanied in the same boat by an adult
Maximum weight limits: Tandem Kayak 400 lbs, Single Kayak 250 lbs, Paddle Board 230 lbs, Pedal Boat 1250 lbs, Canoe 780 lbs
includes: Life jackets included in rental fee
gap: Cancellation policy details beyond no refunds if facility closed
blurb: Shawnee Mission Park Marina offers boat rentals such as kayaks, paddle boards, pedal boats, and canoes. Rentals are for one hour with 30-minute intervals for sanitizing. Guests can rent consecutive hours to stay longer on the lake.
extraNote: No refunds for boat rentals unless facility is closed by staff · All patrons must wear life jackets while on dock or in boat · No alcohol, tobacco or drugs allowed · Renters responsible for damage or loss to boats and equipment · Marina office at Shawnee Mission Park Marina
